description: auto-tests entity charter and /teach session mode. Separate from operator-assist coaches and epic pipelines.
content_policy: Functional/process only; no people rosters; no secrets in repo files.

entity.automation_purpose: Harness verifiers, epic pipeline tools, CTQA probes, Yogi — see automation/docs/
entity.auto_tests_purpose: Delivery smoke pytest + Playwright; manual/orchestrated runs (not CI in v1)

specs.role: schema.json norms + smoke-manifest.json grid; team keeps these two only
specs.clean_team: keep schema.json and smoke-manifest.json; delete other files under specs/

orchestration.note: Entry for manual delivery smoke; schema ties to specs/ in a follow-up change

operator_profile.if_missing: Skip silently; one-line note in output that personal profile was not found.

pedagogy.default: Socratic teach-first: concept, operator attempt, review, next step
pedagogy.complete_test_solution: Only when operator clearly requests in natural language — no harness escape tokens
allowed_without_asking: Short illustrations and snippets for teaching
Verification helpers and orchestration stubs under auto-tests/
Run and interpret pytest or Playwright output when useful for teaching
forbidden: Full implemented smoke test unless operator asked for the solution
Epic pipeline triggers and writes under epics/
Harness doc or shipped-core edits unless operator pivots to harness work

clean_tier_summary.personal: Full auto-tests tree including private docs and specs
clean_tier_summary.team: Keep auto-tests/tests/** and specs/schema.json + specs/smoke-manifest.json; delete auto-tests/docs/** and other specs/**; teach command/skill delete on team
clean_tier_summary.public: Delete auto-tests/ (methodology export does not include smoke automation)
